I need you to find the winner of the British Academy Games Awards 2019 (Game of the Year), then find how many revisions the Wikipedia page for that game had before the game's release date month. The answer needs to reference a 2022 source.

The game is likely Death Stranding (which won Best Game at the BAFTA Games Awards ceremony held in April 2019), released November 8, 2019. But please verify this.

Steps:
1. Use websearch or webfetch to find which game won the Game of the Year award at the British Academy Games Awards in 2019 (15th edition, held April 2019)
2. Confirm the game's release date on its Wikipedia page
3. Use webfetch on the Wikipedia page history (https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=GAME_TITLE&action=history) to count how many revisions existed before the month listed as the game's release date (e.g., November 2019)
4. Report the answer

Use websearch and webfetch tools. Report the game name, its release date (month/year), and how many revisions existed before that month.
